Location comments: Part of the Montezuma NWF, Howland's Island is a multi-use public property. The land area is broken up by several large ponds, swamps, meadows, fields and cattail marshes.  Most of the forested land contains even-aged hardwood stands, though a few very large and old specimens can be found.
250 acres Nature Center and is part of 3,750 acre North Park
